question: Should `TOOL_PROGRESS_KIND` and `isToolProgressPayload` become supported public Plugin SDK API for cross-plugin progress intent?
rationale: A generic typed seam is cleaner than Slack text inference, but committing that seam to third-party plugins is a permanent API-direction decision rather than a mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Accept the generic SDK contract
options.body: Keep the additive marker and predicate after every Slack delivery path is repaired and compatibility coverage is complete.

options.title: Keep the marker internal
options.body: Route progress intent through a bundled-runtime seam instead, avoiding a new public Plugin SDK commitment.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic SDK contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive marker and predicate after every Slack delivery path is repaired and compatibility coverage is complete.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows the strongest combined ownership of Slack native delivery and Plugin SDK surface decisions.
